channel.title: GRAVITY Articles
channel.description: The Gravity Report: an independent NBA analytics publication built around GRAVITY, an original player-value model — numbered articles, registered forecasts, annual audits.

item.title: Article No. 4 — The Kawhi Anomaly: the biggest rebound ever recorded by a 34-year-old
item.description: Kawhi Leonard went from a good starter to the fifth-best player in the league per minute, at 34: the biggest one-year gain ever recorded by a player that age. Late surges usually fade. We rebuild his season piece by piece, predict an impact of +1.31 for 2026-27, and register four forecasts, three of them on public Basketball Reference stats.

item.title: The 30 — every NBA team, one number (July 2026)
item.description: Team GRAVITY: the expected force of one minute of a team's floor time, built from a fixed 240-minute game — counted-on minutes from a two-season blend, draft-slot priors for rookies, uncovered minutes priced at replacement. Starters vs bench force, top-3 concentration, and each team's full allocation. Registered forecast E1: 75% that the July ranking tracks the 2026-27 standings at Spearman ρ ≥ 0.60, graded July 2027. CSV export included.

item.title: The GRAVITY Specification (v3) — the full mathematics of the player-value model
item.description: Every equation, weight, shrinkage rule, tier cut, and the complete injury-override table, published as a standalone citable technical document. Five pages, typeset in LaTeX. PDF: papers/spec.pdf

item.title: Article No. 2 — The Queta Problem: why he’s a top-50 player, and why 2026-27 proves it
item.description: A registered forecast, revised v2 after external review. GRAVITY ranked Neemias Queta #41; this note attacks the number (an empirical on/off persistence model, a 33-season / 22-player comparables engine with a cutoff-sensitivity table), reports honestly that the harshest discount grazes the claim, and registers the forecast: 75% top-50 by July 2027, falsification criteria on the record. PDF: papers/queta.pdf

item.title: Article No. 1 — The Rise and Fall of Ja Morant: a statistical account, 2017–2026
item.description: Seven seasons, one instrument; revised v2 after external review. At the zone level the collapse was 88% shot-making; the three-point crash fits inside its own confidence interval; the free throw improved significantly; and a seven-variation sensitivity appendix shows #140 holds (#112–#147) under every judgment call. PDF: papers/morant.pdf
